profile.headline: Software engineer, esports coach, reality tv aficionado
profile.summary: Computer Science graduate student with interests in computer vision, computer architecture, and machine learning.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description: Skills: IPFS · Cloud Computing · Python3 · Weather Forecasting · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · docker · Embedded Devices · Telemetry · Data Analysis · Prefect Dataflow Automation · NetCDF · GeoJSON · Data Architecture · PostGIS · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Data Warehousing · Databases

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Aided in software development for several medical imagers. 

- Engaged in C# development for film path state machines effectively allowing for medical images to be printed on film.

- Aided in C development for an arm-based microcontroller to ensure proper film path motor behavior.

- Aided in the development of a web-based GUI to assess imager health and function.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
- I developed an application to classify the severity of pediatric dehydration by using computer vision techniques to measuring the capillary refill time for a child’s compressed thumb.

- I wrote technical descriptions of proposed research from a software perspective for several medical grants. In a team of 2, managed to secure funding for said research.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Resolved hundreds of C++, C, and Java warnings/errors for the SAF (Siemens Adaptive Framework) and TNA (Transmission Network Applications) software bases.  

Created scripts to allow Siemens developers to quickly migrate changes from a given Git branch into a ClearCase branch and vis-versa

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description: Utilizing a 2-steam constitutional neural network for activity recognition.

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern
positions.description: Developed language resonance models using convolutional neural networks, and utilized methods for natural language generation.

projects.title: Autonomous UAV
projects.description: Leading a team of University of Minnesota students in creating a fully autonomous vertical take off cargo plane. During the course of this project I have worked with ROS (Robot Operating System), advanced  embedded systems such as the Jestson TK1 and the autopilot based embedded system Pixhawk. In addition I have assisted in the creation of battery charging circuits for an electric-gas hybrid motor, and implemented an AGILE based work system for my team.
